in_english.name: Shehrbano
in_english.meaning: Beautiful and strong-willed woman of noble character
in_english.long_meaning: Shehrbano is a Persian-derived name that signifies a beautiful and strong-willed woman of noble character. Etymologically, it relates to the Arabic roots 'shahr' (شهر) meaning 'city' or 'noble' and 'bano' (بانو) meaning 'woman' or 'lady.' The name embodies qualities of courage, beauty, and dignity. Historically, it has been used in various Muslim cultures to denote a woman of high social standing and moral integrity. In modern usage, Shehrbano remains a popular name across South Asian and Middle Eastern communities, symbolizing feminine strength and elegance.
